Ana (marketing): Need a small reproducible bench for the launch post comparing baseline vs quantized for our demo workload. Want one clear headline stat + an appendix. Can runtime produce a compact artifact bundle and a one-liner for the repo?

Ravi (eng-runtime): Yep. Quick Qs: which headline metric — p50 token latency on short prompts, or end-to-end response time on 64-token outputs? Also which quant recipes to compare?

Ana (marketing): Headline: p50 first-token for short prompts (10-30 tokens) and a note about end-to-end on 64 tokens in appendix. Compare baseline, 8-bit per-channel, and 4-bit mixed.

Tess (measurements): We'll need a stratified 120-sample slice: 60 short (10-30), 40 mid (30-200), 20 long (200+). Uploading as s3://marketing-artifacts/bench/4350012345/slice.csv with manifest.

Ravi (eng-runtime): Plan: run 4 isolated trials per config, and 2 mixed-tenant trials for FAQ. Warmup: 150 steady requests at target concurrency 4. Artifacts to publish: run-config.txt, run-script one-liner, raw traces with first-token timestamps, aggregated percentiles (p50/p90/p95), per-trial checksums, and a README with exact docker tag and bench harness commit.

Ana (marketing): Can you include a single-line command we can paste into the repo for a one-off run?

Ravi (eng-runtime): Example: REDWOOD_API_KEY=redacted ./bench/run_bench.sh --model redwood-demo-2 --quant none --slice s3://marketing-artifacts/bench/4350012345/slice.csv --concurrency 4 --trials 1 --output s3://marketing-artifacts/bench/4350012345/run1/

Tess (measurements): Note: tokenization affects first-token timing. We'll log tokenizer version and seed in the manifest. Also record kernel selection for quant runs.

ci-bot: scheduled bench job 4350012345 -> https://ci.internal/bench/4350012345 (running)

Ravi (eng-runtime): Running now. We'll include an 8-bit run with per-channel and a 4-bit mixed run; include a note about possible long-context regressions for 4-bit.

ci-bot: job 4350012345 completed: artifacts at s3://marketing-artifacts/bench/4350012345/summary.json

Ravi (eng-runtime): Uploaded summary. Headline numbers (isolated): baseline p50=46ms p95=165ms; 8-bit p50=50ms p95=185ms; 4-bit p50=44ms p95=230ms (note p99 increases for long prompts). Mixed-tenant p95 ~1.2x isolated. Full artifacts and run-config at s3://marketing-artifacts/bench/4350012345/.

Ana (marketing): Great. Can you add a 2-line blurb for the release notes explaining methodology and a short caveat about 4-bit tradeoffs?

Ravi (eng-runtime): Blurb: "Latency measured on a curated 120-sample slice; reported percentiles are medians across multiple isolated trials. Appendix includes mixed-tenant runs and quantized variant tradeoffs. Repro artifacts and run scripts at s3://marketing-artifacts/bench/4350012345/." Caveat: "4-bit mixed quantization shows larger cost reduction but may increase tail latency on long-context workloads; see appendix."
